original.target_description: PBGD ApaLI allele-frequency association, affected versus normal controls, Table 1.

n.sample_role: Analytic allele/chromosome counts in the 2 × 2 association contingency table: 106 affected alleles and 102 control alleles. The corresponding contributor count is 104 participants (53 affected, 51 controls), not 208 participants.
n.exclusions: Rare alleles, persistent partial digests, and otherwise unscorable alleles excluded (p. 214). Table 1 final counts used, not the recruitment total of 55 affected and 51 controls. ApaLI Table 2 final genotypes total 53 affected and 51 controls; two affected participants lack usable ApaLI genotype information; specific reasons for those two are not individually stated.

replication.target_description: Patients versus controls; ApaLI allele frequencies (Table I) at PBGD locus, German population association study.

n.sample_role: Participants: 93 unrelated schizophrenia patients plus 74 unrelated controls in the overall P versus C comparison. Table I reports allele frequencies for these participants; Table II reports their genotype counts. This N counts participants, not alleles or families.
n.exclusions: Controls with first-degree relatives with schizophrenia were excluded. One pedigree supplied no patient because all patients diagnosed with schizophrenia had deceased. The final patient sample includes one randomly chosen patient from each of the other pedigrees. No additional target-table exclusions are reported.
